Identifies fragment-only links as anchor type

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import create_engine, scrape

async def main() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(None)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.links[0].link_type)

asyncio.run(main())
```
